rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for a conventional and oversimplified idea about a person or group.

example.english: Many people have a stereotype about housewives, thinking they only know how to look after children.
example.traditional: 好多人對家庭主婦都有刻板印象，以為佢哋淨係識湊仔。
